heading: Product 3D models
assignedSummary: {assigned} of {total} products have a 3D model assigned.
gettingStartedIntro: Three quick steps to publish 3D models on your storefront.
stepDefsDescription: Create custom.model_3d (file) and custom.viewer_3d_config (JSON) with storefront read access.
stepUploadDescription: Pick a product and upload a .glb file. The block automatically reads it on the storefront.
stepBlockDescription: In Online Store → Themes → Customize → Product template, add "3D Viewer — Product" under Apps.
limitProducts: {used} of {limit} products already have a 3D model.
libraryEmpty: Upload standalone 3D models and embed them on any page via the page block.
libraryCount_one: {count} model in your library, ready to embed on pages.

productsIntro: Click a product to upload, replace, or configure its 3D model.
